meta.description: Vitrasa realtime snapshot: next-arrival estimations for every queried stop. Git-scraped: one commit per run.
meta.observation_time: intentionally NOT stored here - the UTC timestamp of the git commit that introduces this blob is the observation time.

realtime_estimations_api.note: realtime_id is embedded in the GTFS stop_code (P0014135 -> 14135)
realtime_estimations_api.returns: next arrivals per stop: minutes, route headsign, line, meters from stop
